gaps.valueSet: Paired acute/convalescent Histoplasma antibody change in source rule 4
gaps.reason: the source explicitly marks this rule inoperable; SEM_V1 cannot compare paired specimens, enforce a two-week collection interval, detect a four-fold titer rise, or detect negative-to-positive seroconversion, so the rule is omitted

gaps.valueSet: Histoplasma complement-fixation antibody titer at least 1:32 in source rule 8
gaps.reason: the source explicitly marks titer-result evaluation as not implemented and SEM_V1 has no titer comparison predicate, so the rule is omitted

gaps.valueSet: Clinical findings plus epidemiologic link in source rule 9
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no epidemiologic-link evidence and cannot evaluate the quantitative temperature alternative; because the epidemiologic link is required, the entire inoperable rule is omitted to prevent symptoms alone from reporting
